purpose: Test whether native quasicircular initial conditions at the compiled reference's earlier start frequency reproduce its state at the requested waveform cutoff.
native_solver: DOP853 with rtol=1e-12, atol=1e-13, first_step=0.125 M, starting at t=0 from native quasicircular r,phi=0,pr_star,pphi.
comparisons: reference state at the nearest sampled cutoff time
native frequency-crossing state versus sampled reference cutoff state
interpretation: Diagnostic only. Agreement at the sampled cutoff does not validate merger, NQC, ringdown, full waveforms, parameter-domain coverage, numerical convergence, or the ROM. The compiled reference is not a native training asset.
